title: stt.languageDetection node config (optional)
description: Selects a language mode from the platform's closed, backend-authoritative catalog (apps/stt/src/stt/pipeline/language_modes.py LANGUAGE_MODE_CATALOG / LanguageModeKind) — never a free-text language string. `mode` mirrors LanguageModeKind ('single' | 'code_switch' | 'auto'); `languageModeId`, when present, must be one of the catalog's own ids. Consistency between `mode` and `languageModeId` (e.g. 'auto' mode ignores languageModeId) is enforced by the impure validator layer via language_modes.py's own `engine_supports_mode`, not re-implemented here — `if`/`then`/`else` is excluded from the authorable subset.
